content:
**Rejuvenated** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Provides increased benefits from being Fully Fed and Fully Hydrated.

While the first rank of the perk does not have any requirements, the second rank requires less than 10% rads. If the player has more than 10% rads, this requirement is not fulfilled and as a result of that only the bonus of the first rank is provided.

| Fully Fed | | | | 
| Rank | Strength | Max HP | Disease Resistance | 
| no perk | +1 | +35 | +35% | 
| Rank 1 | +2 | +45 | +40% | 
| Rank 2 | +4 | +60 | +45% | 

| Fully Hydrated | | | | 
| Rank | Endurance | AP Regen | Disease Resistance | 
| no perk | +1 | +35 | +35% | 
| Rank 1 | +2 | +45 | +40% | 
| Rank 2 | +4 | +60 | +45% | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Benefits of being Well Fed or Hydrated are further increased when you have less than 10% RADS. | 003DE590 | 
| ★ | 1 | You gain increased benefits from being Well Fed or Hydrated. | 003DE58F |
